name: pollybot-ai
label: PollyBot AI
description: Automate lead management with PollyBot AI chatbot integration.

apiKey.label: PollyBot API Key
apiKey.description: Your API Key starting with `sk-workspace_...`. Find your API Key in your [PollyBot Dashboard Settings](https://pollybot.app/docs/authentication).

chatbotId.label: Chatbot ID
chatbotId.description: The unique ID for the specific chatbot (e.g., `cmhm6o40a05h8mn12dv3tc456`). Learn more in the [PollyBot Authentication docs](https://pollybot.app/docs/authentication).

create_lead.label: Create Lead
create_lead.description: Creates a new lead in your PollyBot chatbot.

email.label: Email
email.description: Valid email address. Must be unique for this chatbot.

discord.label: Discord
discord.description: The lead's Discord username or handle (maximum 50 characters).

company.label: Company
company.description: The company or organization name (maximum 100 characters).

message.label: Message
message.description: The inquiry or message submitted by the lead (maximum 1000 characters).

preferredMethod.label: Preferred Method
preferredMethod.description: The contact method preferred by the lead.

urgency.label: Urgency
urgency.description: The urgency level reported by the lead.

source.label: Source
source.description: The origin of the lead (maximum 50 characters, defaults to "api").

customFields.label: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Custom data as a valid JSON object (e.g., {"plan": "enterprise"})

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags attached to the lead (maximum 10 tags, each up to 50 characters).

get_Lead.label: Get Lead
get_Lead.description: Retrieves a specific lead by ID.

id.label: Lead ID
id.description: The unique identifier of the lead to retrieve.

update_lead.label: Update Lead
update_lead.description: Updates an existing lead. Supports partial updates.

id.label: Lead ID
id.description: The unique ID of the lead to update.

name.label: Name
name.description: The full name of the lead (1-100 characters).

email.label: Email
email.description: Valid email address. Must be unique for this chatbot.

discord.label: Discord
discord.description: The lead's Discord username or handle (maximum 50 characters).

company.label: Company
company.description: The company or organization name (maximum 100 characters).

message.label: Message
message.description: The inquiry or message submitted by the lead (maximum 1000 characters).

preferredMethod.label: Preferred Method
preferredMethod.description: The contact method preferred by the lead.

urgency.label: Urgency
urgency.description: The urgency level reported by the lead.

status.label: Status
status.description: Update the pipeline status of the lead.

priority.label: Priority
priority.description: Update the priority level of the lead.

notes.label: Notes
notes.description: Internal notes regarding the lead (maximum 2000 characters).

customFields.label: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Replaces the stored customFields object entirely.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Replaces the stored tags array entirely.

delete_lead.label: Delete Lead
delete_lead.description: Permanently deletes a lead from your PollyBot chatbot.

id.label: Lead ID
id.description: The unique identifier of the lead to delete.
